metadata.title: Active Monsoon (Vigorous Coastal & Ghats Surge)
metadata.description: Deep depression over Bay of Bengal; active monsoon trough across Maharashtra; strong 40-kt low-level westerly jet.

metadata.title: Break Monsoon (Central Indian Quiescent Phase)
metadata.description: Monsoon trough shifted to Himalayan foothills; rainfall suppressed across Deccan plateau; spurious NWP false alarms.

metadata.title: Late Season Depression Transect
metadata.description: Equatorial transition; moderate widespread convective activity over central and eastern basins.
